fwd.title: Forward
fwd.given: scene graph, start state, every physical property, the action

unk100.title: Unknown properties
unk100.given: scene graph, start state, the action; every mass, friction and restitution hidden
unk100.generated: the whole motion and the hidden properties

prefix.title: Completion
prefix.given: scene graph, properties, the action and the first part of the motion

bridge.title: Infilling
bridge.given: scene graph, properties, the action, the start and the end of the motion

cause.title: Backward
cause.given: scene graph, properties, the start state (at rest) and the end state
cause.generated: the action and the whole motion

prop.title: Property inference
prop.given: scene graph, the action and the whole motion
prop.generated: mass, friction and restitution of every movable object

notes.models: The three 200M NeuWorld variants at 150k updates; the answers use the test scoring settings (10 sampling steps, question seed 0).
notes.spans: For completion the first 30% of the motion is given; for infilling the first and the last 20%. These spans are fixed for the page; the test set draws them per simulation.
notes.error: error_m is the position error in metres on this simulation: the mean distance of the moving objects from PhysX over the generated frames.
notes.render: Colours and textures of the floor and walls are changed at render time only; the motion is the simulation's. A piece a model puts below the floor is lifted onto it.
notes.overlay: Arrow coordinates are normalised to the tile (0..1 from the top-left); arrows show direction only.
